quizGuardRationale: Author judgments for independent review: direct ordinary-meaning/actual-label overlap, symmetric and nontransitive. No baseline declaration is changed. Topic association alone is insufficient.
混合 protects 合同/組み合わせ combination labels, 合わせる's actual mixing sense 7 and 素/もと's actual ingredient-mix sense 4. Combined roles on 兼ねる and confusion/crowding are not automatically mixing.

コンセント protects independently attested consent/agreement/permission on 承知/賛成/一致/承認/納得/許可/許す. Contract/promise, legislative passage and accepting orders are not made an approval clique from shared English fragments.
献立 protects 予定/計画 under its actual program/schedule sense; 番組 is explicitly broadcast-qualified. こんばんは does not automatically form a greeting clique with other times of day or 今晩 tonight.

サークル independently protects shape on 丸/輪/円, and direct ordinary group/club meanings or broad labels on 団体/グループ/仲間/会/組/集団/組合/組織/群れ/クラス/チーム/集まり. 学級's expressly school-class meaning is not automatically a club. Existing candidate-to-candidate relations do not generate a transitive clique.

在学 protects 入学 school-enrollment, 出席 attendance and 通う attend-regularly labels, while keeping state, entry event and attendance constructions distinct. 通学 is commuting and 学生 a person noun, not automatic equivalent labels.

再三 protects repeated/frequent senses on しきりに/たびたび/くれぐれも/しばしば/よく/ちょこちょこ/繰り返す/重ねる. よく uses frequency family 1605870:2, not unrelated 欲/翼/翌. A single recurrence or occasional event is not automatically repeated action.
祭日 protects 休日/休み/おやすみ holiday meanings, not automatically the event nouns 祭/お祭り. 催促 protects actual urging/requesting on 要求/請求/頼む/依頼/求める, not the hurried action 急ぐ/あわてる itself.
採点 protects 評価/判断 assessment and externally supported assigned-score overlap with 成績. 災難 protects 不幸/悲劇/事故 directly, not every adverse-experience word 厄介/面倒/苦労.
裁縫/針 uses the positively inspected ordinary sewing sense 1366210:6, not tool association. 材木 protects 木/材料 wood/material labels without importing unrelated ingredient mixes.

逆さ and 逆さま share an explicit pair. Each independently protects applicable inversion on 逆/反対/裏返す/返す/返る, including actual turn-over secondary senses 1512130:2 and 1512150:2, not only return titles. 裏 is a side, not itself inversion.

遡る protects 川上 upstream and 戻る/返る go-back meanings; 帰る is specifically return-home. 酒場 protects 店's ordinary establishment meaning, not an automatic eating-place clique. サイレン does not automatically equal every ベル or 警告. Distinct relative dates are not synonyms.
